overview: Sydney's harbour and beaches, Melbourne's laneways, and the Gold Coast's theme parks and wildlife sanctuaries where you can cuddle koalas (in Queensland) and feed kangaroos.
fit: Excellent for both; long flights, so plan an easy first day.
season: Seasons are reversed. September–November (spring) and March–May (autumn) are ideal. December–February is hot summer and school holidays; June–August is winter (mild in Queensland).

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Sydney or Melbourne (1-stop via Singapore/KL)

gettingAround: Public transport with Opal (Sydney) / Go Card (Brisbane–Gold Coast); a hire car for the Gold Coast.

todo.title: Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge walk
Dreamworld / Movie World / Sea World, Gold Coast
Bondi to Coogee walk and Manly ferry

food.name: Meat pies and fish and chips

save: Apartments with kitchens save a lot
safety: Swim between the red and yellow flags
Wildlife: don't touch unknown spiders or snakes
health: Very high UV: SPF 50+ and hats
Strict biosecurity: declare all food on arrival
kids: The flight is long; get bulkhead seats for the 4-year-old
Holding a koala at Currumbin is the highlight

days.plan: Opera House; ferry to Taronga Zoo

visa: Australian Visitor visa (subclass 600) for everyone, applied online via ImmiAccount; about AUD 195 per person (check current fee). Apply 6–8 weeks ahead with bank statements and ITRs.
